mentions.name: Personal OAuth Provider
mentions.description: This project is a self-built OAuth provider. The author, having built one at work for the last five years, is creating their own implementation to "do it right" despite the many existing options.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building my own OAuth provider. I know there’s a lot of options out there but I’ve built one at work for the last 5 years and I’d like to “do it right”
